remarks: ***Seller requests that all offers for 2 Evergreen Ave, Westport be submitted no later than 5pm, Monday Sept. 14, 2026 for consideration.  Thank you, Tammy Zelkowitz, 203.985.5649  In-town living at its best! Step into a little piece of history with this charming three-bedroom, 2 1/2-bath home, beautifully renovated and situated in Evergreen's historic district just moments from Main Street. Light and airy throughout, this home offers an inviting open floor plan with a warm comfortable feel. The newer kitchen opens seamlessly to a spacious great room with relaxed living and dining areas, anchored by a cozy fireplace; an ideal setting for everyday living and entertaining. Enjoy generous outdoor spaces, including a large deck and stone patio. The private yard provides a wonderful spot to garden, unwind, or savor a cup of coffee. A true condo alternative without giving up privacy, outdoor space, or the appeal of a single-family home. This property is so conveniently located near Westport's Main Street shopping, Compo Beach, Metro-North, and major highways. Part of Westport's history, this timeless home is ready for you to begin its next chapter! Not to be missed!!
